01a0752f.text:
Tarrel my beloved,

Not a day goes by that I don't lose myself thinking of those bronze braids, that bellowing laugh, or those rippling forearms.

You must come to me in Auberdine on the next ship. We belong together--you know it to be true if you search your heart!

Yours if you'll have me,

Hollee
01a0752f.title: Hollee's Note

a46637da.text:
I know how this letter will find you, and I am truly sorry about that, elder.

Without a doubt, I will send any able-bodied adventurers I can through your fine town. I hope their impact will make up for the lack of other support I can bring at this time.

Our lands are pressured by a great many enemies. I'm sure you are no stranger to that world yourself, but it has painfully drained what resources we have.

Should that change, I would love to help, but even then there are many projects close to home that will demand priority.

Hold strong. We're all in this together.

-- Baros Alexston
City Architect, Stormwind
a46637da.title: Alexston's Reply

11065|ad07ed45.name: Thonys Pillarstone
11065|ad07ed45.text: Ye're a fine enchanter indeed! Now it's time fer ye to move on. I want ye to talk to Gimble Thistlefuzz, upstairs. He's a bit of a character, but he'll steer ye in the right direction from here on out!

1285|fe52f4ea.name: Thurman Mullby
1285|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|2237a3b1.name: John Burnside
2457|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

5153|4acd68fa.name: Jormund Stonebrow
5153|4acd68fa.text: Hmm... you show a little promise, I'll give you that. Okay then, where were we?

5157|7805515d.name: Gimble Thistlefuzz
5157|7805515d.text: Great, let's get started... ha! Fooled you! Surely you didn't think it would be that simple. You'll need to prove your mettle just like everyone else!

5511|5ca9cced.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|5ca9cced.text: Ye have the look of a Blacksmith to ye. Soot under the nails, steel in yer bones. Aye, very much the blood of a Blacksmith in yer veins. Which means ye've come to me looking to learn a thing or two, well lad grab a hammer. Let's see what I can teach ye.

5512|211be282.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|b3938781.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|b3938781.text:
Och!  Ye should be careful what ye get enchanted lass.  I had me mug enchanted so it wouldn't spill a drop, but now I can't drink from it!  Such a tragedy.  

You be sure to heed me advice when ye see Gimble.  He'll be in his shop right by the Gryphon Master at The Great Forge.

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

957|a7a421b8.name: Dane Lindgren
957|a7a421b8.text: A far better blacksmith than I am, that's for sure. Though I'll deny it if you tell anyone I said that. You should go speak with Therum Deepforge. If anyone can teach you more, it's him.

2928-accept.name: Shoni the Shilent
2928-accept.text:
It's terrible, $N. We are not going to have enough parts to get our fleet of gyrodrillmatic excavationators to Dun Morogh.

What we need are spare parts, $N. What better place to get the spare parts for our vehicles than Gnomeregan? I hear that bots and mechs roam around that place like cattle on an open range.

What I need you to do is go to Gnomeregan and tear apart those robots. Bring me back their robot guts. Two dozen should be sufficient.
2928-accept.title: Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators

343-complete.name: Milton Sheaf
343-complete.text: Metallurgy?  Ah yes, we have many books on the subject, and are happy to aid Brother Kristoff with his speech!  Now...which particular book was it the good brother needed?
343-complete.title: Speaking of Fortitude

344-accept.name: Milton Sheaf
344-accept.text:
The Stresses of Iron?  Yes, I know the book.  Quite a good one, written by the Dwarven miner Margulf Blaggon a few decades ago.  He spent most his time deep in the mountains of Khaz Modan, digging ore.  Smart fellow!

But where was I?  Oh yes, the Stresses of Iron!  I'm afraid the book was moved to the Northshire Abbey.  The caretaker of the Abbey's library, Brother Paxton, wanted to make a copy of the book for his own shelves.

But that was months ago.  I wonder why it's taking him so long...
344-accept.title: Brother Paxton

344-complete.name: Brother Paxton
344-complete.text: Mr. Sheaf is wondering where his book is?  Well this is a tad embarrassing.  I have the book, but I'm still making my copy and I'm not quite ready to give the original up!
344-complete.title: Brother Paxton

345-accept.name: Brother Paxton
345-accept.text:
I've been meaning to finish my copy of The Stresses of Iron, but...

Well you see, I make my own ink for books I copy.  It's my own recipe; it doesn't run or smear, and it dries very quickly  Unfortunately, it dries too quickly!  My last batch dried up before I could finish the copying job, and I haven't had the chance to make more ink!

To make more I need Rethban Iron Ore from the Redridge Mountains.  Foreman Oslow in Lakeshire is my usual supplier.
345-accept.title: Ink Supplies

91736-progress.name: Unknown
91736-progress.text: A strong scent of apples burns your nose as you inspect the device.
91736-progress.title: Applejack Still
